title: SafeSteps Behaviour Change Curriculum
description: A complete multi-module behaviour change curriculum for parents, caregivers, and family safety practitioners.

easy.text: A parent feels overwhelmed when the child cries loudly and takes a moment to breathe before responding.
A child spills juice and the parent pauses instead of reacting immediately.

medium.text: A parent notices their heart racing during a sibling argument and uses grounding before intervening.

hard.text: A parent with trauma triggers feels panic during a child meltdown and attempts to regulate while staying present.

easy.text: A parent replaces saying 'Stop it!' with 'Let’s try that again safely.'

medium.text: A parent identifies that yelling happens when they are tired and replaces it with a pause-and-breathe routine.

hard.text: A parent with long-standing reactive habits attempts to replace criticism with curiosity during conflict.

easy.text: A parent apologises after raising their voice and offers a hug.

medium.text: A parent explains the impact of their reaction and invites the child to reconnect.

hard.text: A parent attempts repair after a major conflict where the child withdrew emotionally.

easy.text: A parent sets a consistent bedtime routine.

medium.text: A parent maintains consistent expectations even during stressful days.

hard.text: A parent attempts consistency while co-parenting with someone who undermines routines.

easy.text: A parent feels unsure but wants to try calmer communication.

medium.text: A parent recognises ambivalence and seeks clarity before committing to change.

hard.text: A parent in a high-stress environment struggles with readiness and fluctuating motivation.

easy.text: Noise triggers a parent, who steps outside briefly to reset.

medium.text: A parent identifies emotional triggers during conflict and uses grounding.

hard.text: A parent with trauma triggers manages overwhelming flashbacks during a child's meltdown.

easy.text: A parent praises a child for trying, not just succeeding.

medium.text: A parent shifts from conditional praise to consistent encouragement.

hard.text: A parent attempts positive reinforcement despite chronic stress and limited emotional bandwidth.

easy.text: A parent sets a clear rule about screen time.

medium.text: A parent enforces boundaries calmly even when the child protests.

hard.text: A parent attempts healthy boundaries while co-parenting with someone who uses punitive rules.

easy.text: A parent lowers their voice during a disagreement.

medium.text: A parent interrupts escalation by pausing and stepping back.

hard.text: A parent attempts de-escalation during a high-intensity conflict involving multiple children.

easy.text: A parent recognises a harmful pattern and wants to change.

medium.text: A parent practices new behaviour but struggles with consistency.

hard.text: A parent attempts behaviour change while dealing with co-parenting conflict and emotional triggers.
